items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I was away. Slam got with him for a while with Everett Barksdale, but it just didn't go.

ctx.x: I loved to go fishin'. I used to make a little light living crabb'in and cookin' crabs, sellin' papers, shinin' shoes, I did everything....

...I'm quite sure they could have gotten somebody else, there's no gettin' around that... But I think I got an A for effort 'cause I tried. We used to be workin' at a place anywhere and during the intermission they would be looking for me, and I'd be downstairs in the dressing room struggling with the guitar. That's where they had to come get me. That's how bad I wanted to try to keep up. I called myself the low man on the Tatum pole. I tried. I was trying... But some smart all sky agent convinced him he could…
